cases.note: killing case: the sandbox clone must not carry the origin remote into gate runs (S1-no-origin-removal)

base.scripts/g1.sh: if git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'G1: LEAKED'; else echo 'G1: CLEAN'; fi

tip.scripts/g1.sh: if git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'G1: LEAKED'; else echo 'G1: CLEAN'; fi

cases.note: killing case: sandbox reset must remove ignored files between gate runs on the same revision clone (S2-clean-keeps-ignored)

base.scripts/g1.sh:
echo 'G1: CLEAN'
mkdir -p ignored
echo x > ignored/state
base.scripts/g2.sh: if [ -e ignored/state ]; then echo 'G2: STALE'; else echo 'G2: CLEAN'; fi

tip.scripts/g1.sh:
echo 'G1: CLEAN'
mkdir -p ignored
echo x > ignored/state
tip.scripts/g2.sh: if [ -e ignored/state ]; then echo 'G2: STALE'; else echo 'G2: CLEAN'; fi

cases.note: killing case: a gate that prints a verdict then dies by signal is FAIL_CLOSED (signal=SIGKILL), not a verdict reading (V6-signal-ignored)
killing case: trailing whitespace on the verdict line is trimmed before the anchored verdict regex matches (V7-no-trailing-trim)
killing case: the no-verdict FAIL_CLOSED text keeps the gate's last output line (V9-tail-clip-3)
